description: Source code for the ElasticsearchContentIndexProfileHandler class, which manages index profile population and configuration for Elasticsearch integration within OrchardCore.

classes.name: ElasticsearchContentIndexProfileHandler
classes.description: Handles the initialization and updating of Elasticsearch index profiles for OrchardCore content items, including mapping configuration.

methods.name: PopulateAsync
methods.description: Populates the index profile with mappings if it can handle the given profile.

methods.name: CanHandle
methods.description: Determines if the handler can process the given index profile based on provider name and type.

methods.name: PopulateTypeMapping
methods.description: Configures the type mapping properties for the index based on whether source data should be stored.
